place._theme: A quiet site on Akila: somebody's homestead.
place._planet: Akila is in the closed table (SCheyenne_PAkila), as MB98a.

prose.name: Hunt: Mossgnath at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A Mossgnath has wandered in off the plains at the <Place> and won't be driven back out. On Akila, a grazer that size near a homestead brings the Ashta after it. The homesteader wants it put down before it eats the rest of the season's planting.
prose.card: A Mossgnath has wandered in at the <Place> and won't be driven off. A grazer that size brings the Ashta after it. Put it down.

broadcast: It's huge, with moss down its back, you can't miss it. Mossgnath keep to the plains, but this one found our planting and won't go back.
We've tried noise and we've tried lights, and it just keeps eating. It's not doing anything wrong, it's hungry, and we can't afford that much hungry.

beats.objective: Put down the Mossgnath at the <Place>
beats.journal: I put down the Mossgnath that was eating its way through the planting at the <Place>.
say: That's it down. Poor old thing. At least it won't be bringing the Ashta in after it. We'll have the planting back in by the end of the week.
